audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradicted their own prose and the packet: whys[2] says 'you're weakest here relative to him' on a Gragas row, whys[3] says 'keeps the lane even' on a Gragas row, whys[4] calls level 6 'your hardest all-in' on a Graves row, and whys[6] says 'the lane evens out' on a Gragas row.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Graves, Skill, Graves, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill — which is exactly what the whys text describes. Only the chart tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 -> Graves, 3 -> Skill, 4 -> Gragas, 6 -> Skill in both layers, with matching ratings and rewritten phases[].why. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named no cooldowns; Quickdraw was 'his key tool' and Cask was 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12 and gets shorter every time he lands an auto — that detail changes how long a bait actually lasts. Smoke Screen is 26/24/22/20/18, Body Slam 14s, Explosive Cask 100s.
audit.corrected: winCon, tradeGood, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry 16s (and its auto-attack reduction), 26s, 14s and 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most useful interaction in this lane was absent from both layers: Graves's New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so standing behind your own minions eats most of his auto damage.
audit.why: Riot's passive text states it outright — 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units'. It changes where you stand for every trade, and it is not a QSS/tenacity unknown.
audit.corrected: tldr and winCon now tell the player to keep minions between them and Graves.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad stated a whiffed Body Slam as '13 seconds'.
audit.corrected: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d now say 14s and name Quickdraw as the thing that makes it whiff.

notes: No mirror audit existed for this pair, so graves__gragas should restate these facts inverted: Graves ahead levels 1 and 3, even at 2 and 4-5, Gragas ahead at 6 and first item, even at 2+ items. The chart flips are one atomic group across both layers, ratings included. New Destiny's bullets not passing through units is stated in Riot's own passive text and is now on the page — it is the cheapest advantage in the lane and neither layer had it.
